readback.checked: sampling_frequency and rf_bandwidth read off the ad9361-phy channel through raw libiio after every write, on every cell
readback.caveat: the AD9361 driver reports back the REQUESTED baseband bandwidth, not the analog corner it tuned to, so a clean readback proves the driver accepted the write and nothing about the filter; filter_shape measures the corner off the noise floor and finds it ~1.2x wider than requested
